title: PocketPilot
tagline: An experimental privacy-first Android media assistant that routes plain-English requests to safe actions.
stateNote: Early. The README describes an implementation direction as well as what exists.
problem: Phone storage fills up and compressing video is fiddly. PocketPilot would let you ask for what you want and approve each proposed operation before anything changes.
contribution: It is my project. The repository is named 'videocompress'.
worksToday: The README describes storage insights, file selection, safe compression and on-device intent routing.
limitations: I haven't checked how much of the README is built.

involve.headline: What would you ask?
asks: Tell me what you'd ask your phone to clean up.
